🎥🎬: One Battle After Another (2025)

Bob Ferguson, a washed-up former revolutionary, lives off the grid with his teenage daughter Willa after abandoning his radical past. Sixteen years after their lives were torn apart, Bob’s old nemesis, the ruthless Colonel Steven J. Lockjaw, resurfaces—and Willa suddenly goes missing. 

Forced back into action, Bob races to find his daughter while reconnecting with people from his revolutionary past. As the search unfolds, old betrayals, political extremism, secret organizations, and the consequences of their past battles come crashing back into their lives.

Bob’s desperate mission becomes both a rescue operation and a confrontation with the life he tried to leave behind. As father and daughter fight their way through danger, they must finally face the forces that have been chasing their family for years.

source_details.synopsis: One Battle After Another is a 2025 American epic action-comedy thriller film written, directed, and produced by Paul Thomas Anderson. Inspired by the 1990 novel Vineland by Thomas Pynchon, the film's ensemble cast includes Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn, Benicio del Toro, Regina Hall, Teyana Taylor, and Chase Infiniti, in her film debut. The film follows a drug using washed-up former revolutionary who is thrust back into the conflict when an amoral tenacious counterterrorist agent resurfaces after sixteen years to bring them to justice to cover his past sins.
